body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two adjacent empty spaces within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Concentration: create a connected temporary low wall. Each space grants +1 cover across it and has 1 Wound, 0 Resilience. The wall lasts while Concentration is maintained, up to 3 rounds.

surges.html: One wall space has 2 Wounds instead of 1.
One willing creature adjacent to the wall reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Earth Thread
rider.html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.
